verdictStatement: This is a well-grounded candidate and almost every attack failed against measurement rather than against argument. The register row reproduces byte-exactly at file 08 line 289, the acceptance-evidence cell is decomposed into six obligations whose quoted fragments are each an exact substring of that cell and which together cover every one of its six segments, and all eight file-04 properties are carried verbatim with an obligation apiece — I normalised the wrapped source lines and confirmed each property's quoted text is an exact substring of the carried block, then checked each obligation strengthens rather than weakens the source. Every line-level citation I tested resolves: crash safety at L98-102, migration shape at L104-113, reachability roots at L129-135, and the no-loss-code sentence at L137-139. No on-disk encoding is chosen, no D9 or loss code is invented, the DR-103 lock schema is consumed rather than forked, and the word SATISFIED does not appear in the artifact at all. What withholds acceptance is one measurement: the artifact stakes itself on the sentence 'Measured in this authoring session. The bound is the claim', and one of its six bounds no longer reproduces.

shouldFix.title: The recorded COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md bound no longer reproduces, against a blanket this-authoring discipline with no inherited/live split

measurement.theDisciplineItIsMeasuredAgainst: recordedInputs.discipline reads in full: 'Measured in this authoring session. The bound is the claim.' That is a blanket assertion over all six governing sources, and the artifact carries no inherited-pin label, no measuredAt marker, and no live-remeasurement block of the kind the sibling lineages adopted. So one of six bounds is now unbindable on the artifact's own terms.
measurement.whatMovedIt: Three decisions adopted after authoring, each of which appended to the file: C-D103 (5bb125d), C-D104 (499c057) and C-D105 (36949e3). The last is the decision this session recorded, so the pin was current when written and went stale through ordinary lane progress rather than through any edit to the candidate.

shouldFix.whatIVerifiedSoThisIsNotWorse: I did not assume the named properties survived. That entry's role claims three things and all three hold at live bytes: D-002 is present and still carries the DR-110 disposition obligation to draw generation-rollback from self-update-rollback; D-015 is present and its subject's T-2 is exactly the lock-pin-versus-live-negotiation tension the artifact cites; and D-056 is present with its Class A gate still reading 'Class A T2-02 contract or Class B DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED' plus the ineligible-rows clause, which is the sense in which a row with no T2-02 contract is ineligible. Nothing the pin is used for has broken. That is why this is a SHOULD-FIX and not a blocker.
shouldFix.whyItStillMatters: recordedInputs is the artifact's evidence base and 'the bound is the claim' is the strongest possible statement of reliance on it. A reviewer who re-measures meets one unexplained mismatch in six and has no way to tell from the document whether a claim broke — I had to establish that independently against three separate decisions. The lane already has the remedy: the permission-truth-tables and signed-index lineages both label inherited pins, record live remeasurement separately, and re-verify the named properties, and the same defect in the signed-index lineage was recorded and repaired on that pattern.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: In a successor, either re-pin COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md at b9819d6e… or keep the authoring-time value and label it an inherited pin with the live digest recorded separately and the three named properties re-verified. Since the entry's role is three named properties rather than the whole document, saying so explicitly would stop the next adopted decision restaging the same finding. While re-measuring, note that D-104 has since recorded component-manifest-schemas.v11 as DR-103's accepted schema successor; the v2 pin here still reproduces and the claim made on it is true, since D-104 leaves D-013's recording of v2 standing, but a successor may want to name v11 alongside it.

attacksAttemptedAndFailed: That a property was quoted loosely. After normalising the source's wrapped lines, all eight quoted verbatims are exact substrings of the carried block.
That the obligation decomposition covers the cell only approximately. The fragment set equals the semicolon-segment set exactly.
That reserving the mechanism is lip service while an encoding leaks in elsewhere. crashSafety and mechanismReservation both reserve, and no format, grammar or API is named anywhere.
That P-8 quietly designs DR-112's trust state machine. It states the join and hands the machine to DR-112 at ID-DEP-G5.
That G18 is widened into a self-update harness. The scopeRider and ID-DEP-G2 both keep it on the generation side, matching the naming artifact's own rider.
That the preview is given an authoritative-evidence root it does not ship. previewHonesty scopes that root to whatever DR-124 assigns and declines DR-113.
coordinatorNote: The substance here is strong and I want that on the record, because the verdict word alone will understate it. This is the first leftover candidate I have reviewed where every line-level citation I tested resolved exactly, the acceptance cell is decomposed segment-for-segment with verbatim fragments, and the word SATISFIED appears zero times. The single SHOULD-FIX is not about the contract at all: it is that the artifact binds itself with 'the bound is the claim' and one of its six bounds has since moved, because D-103, D-104 and D-105 were adopted after it was authored — the last of those being the decision recorded in this same session. I checked all three properties that pin is used for and every one still holds, so nothing substantive is wrong; what is missing is the inherited-versus-live labelling the sibling lineages already adopted for exactly this situation. DR-107 stays at PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, no encoding is chosen, no loss code is invented, and nothing here marks the row SATISFIED or authorizes docs/v2/implementation/.
